import http.client
import json
import sqlite3
import tempfile
import threading
import time
import unittest
from http.server import BaseHTTPRequestHandler, ThreadingHTTPServer
from pathlib import Path

from chronicleflow.errors import ConflictError, NotFoundError, ValidationError
from chronicleflow.server import Handler
from chronicleflow.service import ChronicleFlow


def nodes_v1():
    return [
        {"id": "reserve", "kind": "task", "depends_on": []},
        {"id": "charge", "kind": "task", "depends_on": ["reserve"]},
    ]


def nodes_v2():
    return nodes_v1() + [{"id": "ship", "kind": "task", "depends_on": ["charge"]}]


class VersionServiceTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.directory = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()
        self.service = ChronicleFlow(str(Path(self.directory.name) / "versions.db"))

    def tearDown(self):
        self.directory.cleanup()

    def create(self, workflow_id, version, nodes, key=None, **extra):
        body = {"id": workflow_id, "nodes": nodes}
        if version is not None:
            body["version"] = version
        body.update(extra)
        return self.service.create_workflow(body, key or f"wf-{workflow_id}-{version}")

    def start(self, execution_id, workflow_id, version=None, key=None, **extra):
        body = {"id": execution_id, "workflow_id": workflow_id, "input": {}}
        if version is not None:
            body["version"] = version
        body.update(extra)
        return self.service.create_execution(body, key or f"ex-{execution_id}")

    def test_versioned_create_response_carries_tag_and_definition_lists_versions(self):
        created = self.create("orders", "v1", nodes_v1())
        self.assertEqual({"id": "orders", "nodes": nodes_v1(), "version": "v1"}, created)
        definition = self.service.get_workflow("orders")
        self.assertEqual("v1", definition["current_version"])
        self.assertEqual(
            [{"id": "orders", "nodes": nodes_v1(), "version": "v1"}], definition["versions"]
        )

    def test_versionless_keeps_baseline_shape(self):
        created = self.service.create_workflow({"id": "plain", "nodes": nodes_v1()}, "wf-plain")
        self.assertEqual({"id": "plain", "nodes": nodes_v1()}, created)
        # The definition view of a versionless workflow is a single untagged
        # revision with a null current version.
        definition = self.service.get_workflow("plain")
        self.assertIsNone(definition["current_version"])
        self.assertEqual([{"id": "plain", "nodes": nodes_v1()}], definition["versions"])
        state = self.service.create_execution(
            {"id": "run-plain", "workflow_id": "plain", "input": {}}, "ex-plain"
        )
        self.assertNotIn("version", state)

    def test_adding_version_keeps_history_and_changes_current(self):
        self.create("orders", "v1", nodes_v1())
        self.create("orders", "v2", nodes_v2(), "wf-orders-v2")
        definition = self.service.get_workflow("orders")
        self.assertEqual("v2", definition["current_version"])
        self.assertEqual(["v1", "v2"], [entry["version"] for entry in definition["versions"]])
        self.assertEqual(nodes_v1(), definition["versions"][0]["nodes"])
        self.assertEqual(nodes_v2(), definition["versions"][1]["nodes"])

    def test_duplicate_version_conflicts_and_writes_nothing(self):
        self.create("orders", "v1", nodes_v1())
        with self.assertRaises(ConflictError):
            self.create("orders", "v1", nodes_v2(), "wf-dup")
        definition = self.service.get_workflow("orders")
        self.assertEqual("v1", definition["current_version"])
        self.assertEqual(["v1"], [entry["version"] for entry in definition["versions"]])

    def test_untagged_post_to_existing_workflow_conflicts(self):
        self.create("orders", "v1", nodes_v1())
        with self.assertRaises(ConflictError):
            self.service.create_workflow({"id": "orders", "nodes": nodes_v2()}, "wf-untagged")

    def test_first_named_version_can_be_added_to_a_versionless_workflow(self):
        self.service.create_workflow({"id": "orders", "nodes": nodes_v1()}, "wf-plain")
        self.create("orders", "v2", nodes_v2(), "wf-orders-v2")
        definition = self.service.get_workflow("orders")
        self.assertEqual("v2", definition["current_version"])
        self.assertEqual([None, "v2"], [entry.get("version") for entry in definition["versions"]])

    def test_invalid_version_identifier_is_a_validation_error(self):
        for bad in (5, True, "", "x" * 101):
            with self.subTest(bad=bad):
                with self.assertRaises(ValidationError):
                    self.create("orders", bad, nodes_v1(), f"wf-bad-{bad!r}")

    def test_execution_binds_current_version_implicitly(self):
        self.create("orders", "v1", nodes_v1())
        self.start("run-1", "orders")
        self.assertEqual("v1", self.service.get_execution("run-1")["version"])
        self.create("orders", "v2", nodes_v2(), "wf-orders-v2")
        self.start("run-2", "orders", key="ex-run-2")
        self.assertEqual("v2", self.service.get_execution("run-2")["version"])
        # The first execution stays pinned to the version current at its start.
        self.assertEqual("v1", self.service.get_execution("run-1")["version"])

    def test_execution_can_name_any_existing_version(self):
        self.create("orders", "v1", nodes_v1())
        self.create("orders", "v2", nodes_v2(), "wf-orders-v2")
        state = self.start("run-old", "orders", version="v1")
        self.assertEqual("v1", state["version"])

    def test_starting_against_missing_workflow_or_version_is_not_found(self):
        self.create("orders", "v1", nodes_v1())
        with self.assertRaises(NotFoundError):
            self.start("run-a", "ghost")
        with self.assertRaises(NotFoundError):
            self.start("run-b", "orders", version="nope")

    def test_running_execution_keeps_advancing_on_old_version_after_upgrade(self):
        self.create("orders", "v1", nodes_v1())
        self.start("run-old", "orders")
        first = self.service.advance("run-old", {"output": {}}, "adv-old-1")
        self.assertEqual(["reserve"], first["completed_nodes"])
        self.create("orders", "v2", nodes_v2(), "wf-orders-v2")
        # The old version has two nodes, so it completes after a second
        # advance; the new third node never appears in this execution.
        done = self.service.advance("run-old", {"output": {}}, "adv-old-2")
        self.assertEqual("completed", done["status"])
        self.assertEqual(["reserve", "charge"], done["completed_nodes"])
        self.assertEqual("v1", done["version"])
        self.assertTrue(self.service.replay("run-old")["consistent"])

    def test_new_execution_after_upgrade_uses_new_version(self):
        self.create("orders", "v1", nodes_v1())
        self.create("orders", "v2", nodes_v2(), "wf-orders-v2")
        self.start("run-new", "orders")
        self.service.advance("run-new", {"output": {}}, "adv-new-1")
        self.service.advance("run-new", {"output": {}}, "adv-new-2")
        done = self.service.advance("run-new", {"output": {}}, "adv-new-3")
        self.assertEqual("completed", done["status"])
        self.assertEqual(["reserve", "charge", "ship"], done["completed_nodes"])
        self.assertEqual("v2", done["version"])

    def test_upgrade_does_not_move_old_execution_when_workflow_started_versionless(self):
        self.service.create_workflow({"id": "orders", "nodes": nodes_v1()}, "wf-plain")
        self.service.create_execution(
            {"id": "run-plain", "workflow_id": "orders", "input": {}}, "ex-plain"
        )
        self.service.advance("run-plain", {"output": {}}, "adv-plain-1")
        self.create("orders", "v2", nodes_v2(), "wf-orders-v2")
        done = self.service.advance("run-plain", {"output": {}}, "adv-plain-2")
        self.assertEqual("completed", done["status"])
        self.assertNotIn("version", done)
        self.assertTrue(self.service.replay("run-plain")["consistent"])

    def test_checkpoint_and_recovery_follow_bound_version(self):
        self.create("orders", "v1", nodes_v1())
        self.start("run-1", "orders")
        self.service.advance("run-1", {"output": {}}, "adv-1")
        self.create("orders", "v2", nodes_v2(), "wf-orders-v2")
        checkpoints = self.service.checkpoints("run-1")["checkpoints"]
        self.assertEqual("v1", checkpoints[-1]["state"]["version"])
        recovered = self.service.recover("run-1", {"from": "latest_checkpoint"}, "rec-1")
        self.assertEqual("v1", recovered["version"])
        done = self.service.advance("run-1", {"output": {}}, "adv-2")
        self.assertEqual("completed", done["status"])

    def test_replay_rebuilds_binding_from_event_stream(self):
        self.create("orders", "v1", nodes_v1())
        self.start("run-1", "orders")
        self.create("orders", "v2", nodes_v2(), "wf-orders-v2")
        self.service.advance("run-1", {"output": {}}, "adv-1")
        result = self.service.replay("run-1")
        self.assertTrue(result["consistent"])
        self.assertEqual("v1", result["execution"]["version"])
        events = self.service.events("run-1")
        self.assertEqual("v1", events[0]["payload"]["version"])

    def test_retries_follow_bound_version(self):
        self.create(

class _RecordingServer:
    def __init__(self):
        class Receiver(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
            def log_message(self, *args):
                return

            def do_POST(self):
                length = int(self.headers.get("Content-Length", "0"))
                self.rfile.read(length)
                self.requests_attr.append(self.path)
                self.send_response(200)
                self.send_header("Content-Length", "0")
                self.end_headers()

        self.requests = []
        Receiver.requests_attr = self.requests
        self.server = ThreadingHTTPServer(("127.0.0.1", 0), Receiver)
        self.url = f"http://127.0.0.1:{self.server.server_address[1]}/hook"
        self.thread = None

    def start(self):
        self.thread = threading.Thread(target=self.server.serve_forever, daemon=True)
        self.thread.start()

    def shutdown(self):
        self.server.shutdown()
        self.server.server_close()

            self.proc.terminate()
            try:

            except Exception:
                self.proc.kill()

def check(condition, message):
    if not condition:
        raise AssertionError(message)


def stream_of(data):
    payload = json.loads(data)
    if isinstance(payload, dict):
        return payload['events']
    return payload


def loop_nodes(limit):
    return [
        {'id': 'attempt', 'kind': 'task', 'depends_on': []},
        {'id': 'keep_trying', 'kind': 'condition', 'depends_on': ['attempt'], 'path': 'go', 'equals': True},
        {'id': 'rounds', 'kind': 'loop', 'depends_on': [], 'entry': 'attempt', 'condition': 'keep_trying', 'max_iterations': limit},
    ]


def main():
    tmp = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()
    product = Product(str(Path(tmp.name) / 'behaviour.db'))
    try:
        status, data = product.request(
            'POST', '/workflows',
            {'id': 'retry-wf', 'version': 'v1', 'nodes': [{'id': 't', 'kind': 'task', 'depends_on': [], 'retries': 1}]},
            {'Idempotency-Key': 'retry-v1'})
        check(status == 201, 'v1 with a retry must be created, got %d' % status)
        status, data = product.request(
            'POST', '/executions',
            {'id': 'run-r1', 'workflow_id': 'retry-wf', 'input': {}},
            {'Idempotency-Key': 'run-r1'})
        check(status == 201 and json.loads(data).get('version') == 'v1', 'run-r1 must bind v1, got %r' % (json.loads(data),))
        status, data = product.request(
            'POST', '/workflows',
            {'id': 'retry-wf', 'version': 'v2', 'nodes': [{'id': 't', 'kind': 'task', 'depends_on': [], 'retries': 0}]},
            {'Idempotency-Key': 'retry-v2'})
        check(status == 201, 'v2 without a retry must be created, got %d' % status)
        status, data = product.request(
            'POST', '/executions',
            {'id': 'run-r2', 'workflow_id': 'retry-wf', 'input': {}},
            {'Idempotency-Key': 'run-r2'})
        check(status == 201 and json.loads(data).get('version') == 'v2', 'run-r2 must bind v2, got %r' % (json.loads(data),))

        status, data = product.request(
            'POST', '/executions/run-r1/advance', {'failure': {'reason': 'boom'}},
            {'Idempotency-Key': 'r1-fail-1'})
        check(status == 200, 'a failure must be accepted, got %d' % status)
        state = json.loads(data)
        check(state['status'] == 'running', "v1's retry must keep the run going, got %r" % (state['status'],))
        check(state['attempts']['t'].get('failures') == 1, 'the failure must be counted, got %r' % (state['attempts'],))

        status, data = product.request(
            'POST', '/executions/run-r2/advance', {'failure': {'reason': 'boom'}},
            {'Idempotency-Key': 'r2-fail-1'})
        check(status == 200, 'a failure must be accepted, got %d' % status)
        state = json.loads(data)
        check(state['status'] == 'terminated', "v2's task has no retry left, got %r" % (state['status'],))
        check(state.get('termination_reason') == 'retries_exhausted',
              'the run must end with retries_exhausted, got %r' % (state.get('termination_reason'),))

        status, data = product.request(
            'POST', '/executions/run-r1/advance', {'failure': {'reason': 'boom'}},
            {'Idempotency-Key': 'r1-fail-2'})
        check(status == 200, 'a failure must be accepted, got %d' % status)
        state = json.loads(data)
        check(state['status'] == 'terminated', 'the second failure exhausts the bound retry, got %r' % (state['status'],))
        check(state.get('termination_reason') == 'retries_exhausted', 'the run must end with retries_exhausted')
        check(state['attempts']['t'].get('failures') == 2, 'both failures must be counted, got %r' % (state['attempts'],))

        status, data = product.request(
            'POST', '/workflows',
            {'id': 'appr-wf', 'version': 'v1', 'nodes': [{'id': 'gate', 'kind': 'task', 'depends_on': [], 'approval': {'approvers': ['alice']}}]},

            {'Idempotency-Key': 'appr-v2'})
        check(status == 201, 'v2 with another approver must be created, got %d' % status)

        status, data = product.request(

        check(status == 200, 'the advance must be accepted, got %d' % status)

              'the guarded task must run in v1, got %r' % (state['completed_nodes'],))

        status, data = product.request(
            'POST', '/executions/run-c2/advance', {'output': {'fast': True}},
            {'Idempotency-Key': 'c2-adv'})
        check(status == 200, 'run-c2 must accept an advance, got %d' % status)
        state = json.loads(data)
        check(state['status'] == 'completed', 'run-c2 must complete, got %r' % (state['status'],))
        check(state['condition_results'].get('is_vip') is False,
              'the bound condition must evaluate false, got %r' % (state['condition_results'],))
        check('expedite' in state['skipped_nodes'],
              'the guarded task must be skipped in v2, got %r' % (state['skipped_nodes'],))
        check('expedite' not in state['completed_nodes'],
              'a skipped task must not complete, got %r' % (state['completed_nodes'],))

        status, data = product.request(
            'POST', '/workflows',
            {'id': 'loop-wf', 'version': 'v1', 'nodes': loop_nodes(2)},
            {'Idempotency-Key': 'loop-v1'})
        check(status == 201, 'v1 of loop-wf must be created, got %d' % status)
        status, data = product.request(
            'POST', '/workflows',
            {'id': 'loop-wf', 'version': 'v2', 'nodes': loop_nodes(3)},
            {'Idempotency-Key': 'loop-v2'})
        check(status == 201, 'v2 of loop-wf must be created, got %d' % status)

        for run_id, bound, rounds in (('run-lo1', 'v1', 2), ('run-lo2', 'v2', 3)):
            status, data = product.request(
                'POST', '/executions',
                {'id': run_id, 'workflow_id': 'loop-wf', 'version': bound, 'input': {'go': True}},
                {'Idempotency-Key': run_id})
            check(status == 201, '%s must start, got %d' % (run_id, status))
            check(json.loads(data).get('version') == bound, '%s must bind %s, got %r' % (run_id, bound, json.loads(data)))
            for step in range(10):
                status, data = product.request(
                    'POST', '/executions/%s/advance' % run_id, {'output': {'step': step}},
                    {'Idempotency-Key': '%s-adv-%d' % (run_id, step)})
                check(status == 200, '%s must accept advances, got %d' % (run_id, status))
                if json.loads(data)['status'] != 'running':
                    break
            state = json.loads(data)
            check(state['status'] == 'completed', '%s must complete, got %r' % (run_id, state['status'],))
            check('rounds' in state['loops'], '%s must expose its loop, got %r' % (run_id, state['loops'],))
            check(state['loops']['rounds'].get('end_reason') == 'iteration_limit',
                  '%s must end at its iteration limit, got %r' % (run_id, state['loops']['rounds'],))
            status, data = product.request('GET', '/executions/%s/events' % run_id)
            events = stream_of(data)
            started = [event for event in events if event['type'] == 'iteration_started']
            check(len(started) == rounds,
                  '%s must run %d loop rounds, got %d' % (run_id, rounds, len(started)))

        status, data = product.request(
            'POST', '/executions',
            {'id': 'run-lo3', 'workflow_id': 'loop-wf', 'version': 'v1', 'input': {'go': False}},
            {'Idempotency-Key': 'run-lo3'})
        check(status == 201, 'run-lo3 must start, got %d' % status)
        for step in range(3):
            status, data = product.request(
                'POST', '/executions/run-lo3/advance', {'output': {'step': step}},
                {'Idempotency-Key': 'lo3-adv-%d' % step})
            check(status == 200, 'run-lo3 must accept advances, got %d' % status)
            if json.loads(data)['status'] != 'running':
                break
        state = json.loads(data)
        check(state['status'] == 'completed', 'run-lo3 must complete, got %r' % (state['status'],))
        check(state['loops']['rounds'].get('end_reason') == 'condition_false',
              'a false loop condition ends with condition_false, got %r' % (state['loops']['rounds'],))
        status, data = product.request('GET', '/executions/run-lo3/events')
        events = stream_of(data)
        started = [event for event in events if event['type'] == 'iteration_started']
        check(len(started) == 0, 'a false loop condition starts no iteration, got %d' % len(started))
    finally:
        product.stop()
        try:
            tmp.cleanup()
        except OSError:
            pass

def make_loop(judge_field, judge, entry, max_iterations, depends_on, node_id="loop"):
    node = {
        "id": node_id,
        "kind": "loop",
        "depends_on": list(depends_on),
        "entry": entry,
        judge_field: judge,
        "max_iterations": max_iterations,
    }
    return node


def resolve_judge_field(product):
    """Return the spelling of the loop judgment reference this product accepts.

    The public contract demands that unknown fields in a loop definition are
    rejected with 400 validation_error, so every spelling the product does not
    accept must fail exactly that way.
    """
    accepted = []
    for index, spelling in enumerate(("condition", "condition_id")):
        nodes = [
            {"id": "check", "kind": "condition", "depends_on": [], "path": "more", "equals": True},
            {"id": "attempt", "kind": "task", "depends_on": ["check"]},
            make_loop(spelling, "check", "attempt", 2, [], node_id="probe-" + spelling),
        ]
        status, data, parsed = product.json_call(
            "POST", "/workflows", {"id": "probe-" + spelling, "nodes": nodes}, key="probe-key-" + str(index)
        )
        if status == 201:
            accepted.append(spelling)
            check(parsed == {"id": "probe-" + spelling, "nodes": nodes}, "loop definition round-trips with " + spelling)
        else:
            check(status == 400, "rejected spelling " + spelling + " answered 400, got " + str(status))
            check(isinstance(parsed, dict) and parsed.get("error", {}).get("code") == "validation_error",
                  "rejected spelling " + spelling + " carries code validation_error")
    check(len(accepted) >= 1, "the product accepts a loop judgment reference spelling")
    return accepted


def run_core(product, judge_field):
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # 1. loop definition validation (each case isolates one rule)
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    good_check = {"id": "check", "kind": "condition", "depends_on": [], "path": "more", "equals": True}
    good_attempt = {"id": "attempt", "kind": "task", "depends_on": ["check"]}

    def wf(nodes, wid, key):
        return product.json_call("POST", "/workflows", {"id": wid, "nodes": nodes}, key=key)

    invalid_cases = [
        ("unknown field on loop", [good_check, good_attempt,
         dict(make_loop(judge_field, "check", "attempt", 2, []), note="x")]),
        ("empty entry", [good_check, good_attempt, make_loop(judge_field, "check", "", 2, [])]),
        ("unknown entry", [good_check, good_attempt, make_loop(judge_field, "check", "ghost", 2, [])]),
        ("entry is not a task", [good_check, good_attempt, make_loop(judge_field, "check", "check", 2, [])]),
        ("judgment is not a condition", [good_check, good_attempt, make_loop(judge_field, "attempt", "attempt", 2, [])]),
        ("judgment unknown", [good_check, good_attempt, make_loop(judge_field, "ghost", "attempt", 2, [])]),
        ("judgment outside the body",
         [good_check, good_attempt,
          {"id": "other", "kind": "condition", "depends_on": [], "path": "x", "equals": 1},
          make_loop(judge_field, "other", "attempt", 2, [])]),
        ("empty body",
         [{"id": "check", "kind": "condition", "depends_on": [], "path": "more", "equals": True},
          make_loop(judge_field, "check", "check", 2, [])]),
        ("entry depends on the loop itself",
         [good_check, {"id": "attempt", "kind": "task", "depends_on": ["check", "loop"]},
          make_loop(judge_field, "check", "attempt", 2, [])]),
        ("zero iterations", [good_check, good_attempt, make_loop(judge_field, "check", "attempt", 0, [])]),
        ("negative iterations", [good_check, good_attempt, make_loop(judge_field, "check", "attempt", -1, [])]),
        ("iterations over the limit", [good_check, good_attempt, make_loop(judge_field, "check", "attempt", 101, [])]),
        ("non finite iterations", [good_check, good_attempt,
         dict(make_loop(judge_field, "check", "attempt", 2, []), max_iterations=None)]),
        ("fractional iterations", [good_check, good_attempt, make_loop(judge_field, "check", "attempt", 2.5, [])]),
        ("loop depends on its body", [good_check, good_attempt, make_loop(judge_field, "check", "attempt", 2, ["attempt"])]),
        ("outside node depends on body",
         [good_check, good_attempt, make_loop(judge_field, "check", "attempt", 2, []),
          {"id": "tail", "kind": "task", "depends_on": ["attempt"]}]),
    ]
    for index, (name, nodes) in enumerate(invalid_cases):
        status, data, parsed = wf(nodes, "bad-" + str(index), "bad-key-" + str(index))
        check(status == 400, name + " -> 400, got " + str(status))
        check(isinstance(parsed, dict) and parsed.get("error", {}).get("code") == "validation_error",
              name + " -> code validation_error")
        check(data.endswith(b"\n") and not data.endswith(b"\n\n"), name + " error body ends with a single newline")

    # a non-finite max_iterations is expressed without a NaN literal: 1e400
    # overflows to Infinity on parse and must also be rejected.
    huge_doc = {"id": "bad-huge", "nodes": [good_check, good_attempt,
                make_loop(judge_field, "check", "attempt", 2, [])]}
    huge_body = json.dumps(huge_doc).replace('"max_iterations": 2', '"max_iterations": 1e400').encode("utf-8")
    status, data, parsed = product.json_call("POST", "/workflows", raw_bytes=huge_body, key="bad-huge-key")
    check(status == 400 and isinstance(parsed, dict) and parsed.get("error", {}).get("code") == "validation_error",
          "non finite max_iterations -> 400 validation_error")

    # valid loop definition is stored and returned unchanged
    nodes = [good_check, good_attempt, make_loop(judge_field, "check", "attempt", 2, ["prepare-x"])]
    nodes.insert(0, {"id": "prepare-x", "kind": "task", "depends_on": []})
    status, data, parsed = wf(nodes, "good-def", "good-def-key")
    check(status == 201 and parsed == {"id": "good-def", "nodes": nodes}, "valid loop definition round-trips exactly")

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # 2. zero round loop: false judgment, no output consumed
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    zero_nodes = [
        {"id": "check", "kind": "condition", "depends_on": [], "path": "more", "equals": True},
        {"id": "attempt", "kind": "task", "depends_on": ["check"]},
        make_loop(judge_field, "check", "attempt", 3, [], node_id="loop"),
    ]
    check(wf(zero_nodes, "zero-flow", "zero-flow-key")[0] == 201, "zero-round workflow created")
    status, data, parsed = product.json_call(
        "POST", "/executions", {"id": "run-zero", "workflow_id": "zero-flow", "input": {"more": False}}, key="zero-exec")
    check(status == 201, "zero-round execution created")
    check(parsed.get("status") == "running", "execution starts running")
    check(parsed.get("loops", {}).get("loop", {}).get("iterations") == [], "pending loop has zero iterations")
    status, data, parsed = product.json_call(
        "POST", "/executions/run-zero/advance", {"output": {"never": "used"}}, key="zero-advance-1")
    check(status == 200, "advance on the zero-round flow answered 200")
    check(parsed.get("status") == "completed", "false judgment completes the execution")
    check(parsed.get("outputs") == {}, "false judgment consumes no submitted output")
    loop_state = parsed.get("loops", {}).get("loop", {})
    check(loop_state.get("end_reason") == "condition_false", "zero rounds recorded end reason condition_false")
    check(loop_state.get("iterations") == [], "zero rounds recorded no iteration")
    check("loop" in parsed.get("completed_nodes", []), "finished loop node satisfies its successors")
    ev = events_of(product, "run-zero")
    types = [e.get("type") for e in ev]
    check(types.count("execution_completed") == 1, "exactly one execution_completed event")
    check(sum(1 for e in ev if set(e.get("payload", {})) == {"loop_id", "iteration"} and e["payload"].get("loop_id") == "loop") == 0,
          "false judgment starts no iteration")
    check(sum(1 for e in ev if e.get("payload", {}).get("reason") in ("condition_false", "iteration_limit")
              and e.get("payload", {}).get("loop_id") == "loop") == 1, "exactly one loop end event carries the end reason")
    status, data, parsed = product.json_call("POST", "/executions/run-zero/replay", {})
    check(status == 200 and parsed.get("consistent") is True, "replay reports consistent for the zero-round loop")
    st = product.json_call("GET", "/executions/run-zero")[2]
    check(parsed.get("execution") == st, "replay rebuild equals the materialized state")
    status, data, parsed = product.json_call(
        "POST", "/executions/run-zero/advance", {"output": {"extra": 1}}, key="zero-advance-2")
    check(status == 200 and parsed == st, "advancing a finished execution returns it unchanged")
    check(parsed.get("outputs") == {}, "advancing a finished execution absorbs no output")

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # 3. loop running to the iteration limit
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    limit_nodes = [
        {"id": "prepare", "kind": "task", "depends_on": []},
        {"id": "check", "kind": "condition", "depends_on": [], "path": "more", "equals": True},
        {"id": "attempt", "kind": "task", "depends_on": ["check"]},
        make_loop(judge_field, "check", "attempt", 2, ["prepare"], node_id="loop"),
        {"id": "finish", "kind": "task", "depends_on": ["loop"]},
    ]
    check(wf(limit_nodes, "limit-flow", "limit-flow-key")[0] == 201, "limit workflow created")
    status, data, parsed = product.json_call(
        "POST", "/executions", {"id": "run-limit", "workflow_id": "limit-flow", "input": {"more": True}}, key="limit-exec")
    check(status == 201, "limit execution created")
    first = product.json_call("POST", "/executions/run-limit/advance", {"output": {"prepared": 1}}, key="lim-a1")[2]
    check(first.get("completed_nodes") == ["prepare"], "external dependency completes first")
    check(first.get("outputs") == {"prepare": {"prepared": 1}}, "body outputs never land in the execution outputs")
    loop_running = first.get("loops", {}).get("loop", {})
    check(loop_running.get("iterations") != [], "true judgment starts the first iteration")
    check(loop_running.get("end_reason") is None, "running loop has no end reason yet")
    second = product.json_call("POST", "/executions/run-limit/advance", {"output": {"n": 1}}, key="lim-a2")[2]
    third = product.json_call("POST", "/executions/run-limit/advance", {"output": {"n": 2}}, key="lim-a3")[2]
    loop_done = third.get("loops", {}).get("loop", {})
    check(loop_done.get("end_reason") == "iteration_limit", "reaching the limit ends with iteration_limit")
    check(len(loop_done.get("iterations", [])) == 2, "no iteration beyond max_iterations is created")
    check(loop_done.get("iterations", [])[0].get("outputs") == {"attempt": {"n": 1}}, "first iteration keeps its own output")
    check(loop_done.get("iterations", [])[1].get("outputs") == {"attempt": {"n": 2}}, "second iteration keeps its own output")
    check(third.get("outputs") == {"prepare": {"prepared": 1}}, "iteration outputs are not written to the execution outputs")
    fourth = product.json_call("POST", "/executions/run-limit/advance", {"output": {"done": True}}, key="lim-a4")[2]
    check(fourth.get("status") == "completed", "loop successor is released after the loop ends")
    check(fourth.get("completed_nodes") == ["prepare", "loop", "finish"], "outside nodes run exactly once")
    check(fourth.get("outputs") == {"prepare": {"prepared": 1}, "finish": {"done": True}},
          "outside outputs are recorded exactly once")
    ev = events_of(product, "run-limit")
    starts = [e for e in ev if set(e.get("payload", {})) == {"loop_id", "iteration"} and e["payload"].get("loop_id") == "loop"]
    check(len(starts) == 2, "event stream records one iteration start per round")
    ends = [e for e in ev if e.get("payload", {}).get("reason") in ("condition_false", "iteration_limit")]
    check(len(ends) == 1 and ends[0]["payload"].get("reason") == "iteration_limit",
          "event stream records the single end reason iteration_limit")
    body_completed = [e.get("payload", {}).get("node_id") for e in ev
                      if e.get("type") == "node_completed" and e.get("payload", {}).get("loop_id") == "loop"]
    body_conditions = [e.get("payload", {}).get("node_id") for e in ev
                       if e.get("type") == "condition_evaluated" and e.get("payload", {}).get("loop_id") == "loop"]
    check(body_completed == ["attempt", "attempt"], "each round completes its body task once")
    check(body_conditions == ["check", "check"], "each round evaluates its body condition once")
    order = []
    for e in ev:
        p = e.get("payload", {})
        if p.get("loop_id") == "loop" and e.get("type") in ("node_completed", "condition_evaluated", "node_skipped"):
            order.append((p.get("iteration"), p.get("node_id")))
    check(order == [(1, "check"), (1, "attempt"), (2, "check"), (2, "attempt")] or
          order == [(1, "attempt"), (1, "check"), (2, "attempt"), (2, "check")],
          "each round keeps its own deterministic node order")
    status, data, parsed = product.json_call("POST", "/executions/run-limit/replay", {})
    st = product.json_call("GET", "/executions/run-limit")[2]
    check(status == 200 and parsed.get("consistent") is True, "replay reports consistent for a finished loop")
    check(parsed.get("execution") == st, "replay rebuild equals the materialized state")
    again = data2 = product.raw("GET", "/executions/run-limit")
    check(st == json.loads(again[1].decode("utf-8")), "repeated inspection is byte stable")
    check(again[1].endswith(b"\n") and not again[1].endswith(b"\n\n"), "inspection response ends with a single newline")

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # 4. guards inside the loop body
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    guard_nodes = [
        {"id": "check", "kind": "condition", "depends_on": [], "path": "flag", "equals": True},
        {"id": "maybe", "kind": "task", "depends_on": ["check"],
         "run_if": {"condition_id": "check", "expected": False}},
        {"id": "act", "kind": "task", "depends_on": ["maybe"]},
        make_loop(judge_field, "check", "act", 1, [], node_id="loop"),
    ]
    check(wf(guard_nodes, "guard-flow", "guard-flow-key")[0] == 201, "guarded loop workflow created")
    product.json_call("POST", "/executions", {"id": "run-guard", "workflow_id": "guard-flow", "input": {"flag": True}}, key="guard-exec")
    gstate = product.json_call("POST", "/executions/run-guard/advance", {"output": {"acted": 1}}, key="guard-a1")[2]
    check(gstate.get("status") == "completed", "guarded loop finishes its round")
    loop_g = gstate.get("loops", {}).get("loop", {})
    check(loop_g.get("end_reason") == "iteration_limit", "single round loop ends with iteration_limit")
    check(loop_g.get("iterations", [])[0].get("outputs") == {"act": {"acted": 1}}, "guarded round keeps the acted output")
    gev = events_of(product, "run-guard")
    skipped = [e for e in gev if e.get("type") == "node_skipped" and e.get("payload", {}).get("loop_id") == "loop"]
    check([e["payload"].get("node_id") for e in skipped] == ["maybe"], "guard mismatch skips the body task each round")
    cond = [e for e in gev if e.get("type") == "condition_evaluated" and e.get("payload", {}).get("loop_id") == "loop"]
    check([e["payload"].get("result") for e in cond] == [True], "body condition is re-evaluated inside the round")

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # 5. numeric fidelity of new fields and of round outputs
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    float_nodes = [
        {"id": "check", "kind": "condition", "depends_on": [], "path": "more", "equals": True},
        {"id": "attempt", "kind": "task", "depends_on": ["check"]},
        make_loop(judge_field, "check", "attempt", 1, [], node_id="loop"),
    ]
    check(wf(float_nodes, "float-flow", "float-flow-key")[0] == 201, "float workflow created")
    product.json_call("POST", "/executions", {"id": "run-float", "workflow_id": "float-flow", "input": {"more": True, "z": -0.0}}, key="float-exec")
    fstate = product.json_call("POST", "/executions/run-float/advance",
                               {"output": {"zero": -0.0, "precise": 0.30000000000000004}}, key="float-a1")[2]
    body = json.dumps(fstate).encode("utf-8")
    check(b"-0.0" in body, "negative zero survives serialization")
    check(0.30000000000000004 in (fstate.get("loops", {}).get("loop", {}).get("iterations", [{}])[0].get("outputs", {}).get("attempt") or {}).values(),
          "float keeps its full precision")
    st2 = product.raw("GET", "/executions/run-float")[1]
    check(st2.endswith(b"\n") and not st2.endswith(b"\n\n"), "state response ends with a single newline")

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # 6. transport level contract
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    status, data = product.raw("GET", "/health")
    check(status == 200 and json.loads(data.decode("utf-8")) == {"status": "ok"}, "health endpoint answers with status ok")
    check(data.endswith(b"\n") and not data.endswith(b"\n\n"), "health response ends with a single newline")
    status, data, parsed = product.json_call("POST", "/executions", {"id": "run-nf", "workflow_id": "float-flow", "input": {"v": 9007199254740993.0}}, key="nf-key")
    check(status == 201, "finite request body is accepted")
    status, data, parsed = product.json_call("POST", "/workflows", {"id": "bad-syntax", "nodes": []}, key="bad-syntax-key")
    check(status == 400 and parsed.get("error", {}).get("code") == "validation_error", "invalid workflow is rejected with validation_error")
    status, data, parsed = product.json_call("POST", "/workflows", raw_bytes=b"{not json", key="bad-json")
    check(status == 400 and isinstance(parsed, dict) and parsed.get("error", {}).get("code") == "validation_error", "malformed body is rejected with validation_error")
    status, data, parsed = product.json_call("POST", "/workflows", raw_bytes=b'{"id":"nf","nodes":[]}', key="nf-wf")
    status, data, parsed = product.json_call("POST", "/executions", raw_bytes=b'{"id":"run-nan","workflow_id":"float-flow","input":{"v":NaN}}', key="nan-key")
    check(status == 400 and isinstance(parsed, dict) and parsed.get("error", {}).get("code") == "validation_error",
          "non finite request value is rejected with validation_error")
    status, data, parsed = product.json_call("GET", "/executions/missing-run")
    check(status == 404 and parsed.get("error", {}).get("code") == "not_found", "missing execution answers 404 not_found")
    status, data, parsed = product.json_call("POST", "/executions", {"id": "run-miss", "workflow_id": "missing", "input": {}}, key="miss-key")
    check(status == 404 and parsed.get("error", {}).get("code") == "not_found", "missing workflow answers 404 not_found")
    status, data, parsed = product.json_call("POST", "/workflows", {"id": "idem-wf", "nodes": [{"id": "a", "kind": "task", "depends_on": []}]})
    check(status == 400 and parsed.get("error", {}).get("code") == "validation_error", "missing idempotency key answers 400 validation_error")

def make_loop(judge_field, judge, entry, max_iterations, depends_on, node_id="loop"):
    node = {
        "id": node_id,
        "kind": "loop",
        "depends_on": list(depends_on),
        "entry": entry,
        judge_field: judge,
        "max_iterations": max_iterations,

def resolve_judge_field(product):
    """Return the spelling of the loop judgment reference this product accepts.

    The public contract demands that unknown fields in a loop definition are
    rejected with 400 validation_error, so every spelling the product does not
    accept must fail exactly that way.
    """
    accepted = []
    for index, spelling in enumerate(("condition", "condition_id")):
        nodes = [
            {"id": "check", "kind": "condition", "depends_on": [], "path": "more", "equals": True},
            {"id": "attempt", "kind": "task", "depends_on": ["check"]},
            make_loop(spelling, "check", "attempt", 2, [], node_id="probe-" + spelling),
        ]
        status, data, parsed = product.json_call(
            "POST", "/workflows", {"id": "probe-" + spelling, "nodes": nodes}, key="probe-key-" + str(index)
        )
        if status == 201:
            accepted.append(spelling)
            check(parsed == {"id": "probe-" + spelling, "nodes": nodes}, "loop definition round-trips with " + spelling)
        else:
            check(status == 400, "rejected spelling " + spelling + " answered 400, got " + str(status))
            check(isinstance(parsed, dict) and parsed.get("error", {}).get("code") == "validation_error",
                  "rejected spelling " + spelling + " carries code validation_error")
    check(len(accepted) >= 1, "the product accepts a loop judgment reference spelling")
    return accepted

"""Acceptance checks that retries, approvals, leases, conditions and loop rounds follow the bound version."""

import http.client
import json
import socket
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
import time
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
SRCDIR = ROOT / 'src'


def free_port():
    sock = socket.socket(socket.AF_INET, socket.SOCK_STREAM)
    sock.bind(('127.0.0.1', 0))
    port = sock.getsockname()[1]
    sock.close()
    return port


class Product:
    def __init__(self, db_path):
        self.port = free_port()
        self.db_path = str(db_path)
        self.log = open(self.db_path + '.server.log', 'wb')
        self.proc = subprocess.Popen(
            [sys.executable, '-m', 'chronicleflow.server', '--host', '127.0.0.1',
             '--port', str(self.port), '--database', self.db_path],
            cwd=str(SRCDIR), stdout=self.log, stderr=self.log)
        deadline = time.time() + 30
        while time.time() < deadline:
            try:
                status, _ = self.request('GET', '/health')
                if status == 200:
                    return
            except OSError:
                pass
            time.sleep(0.1)
        raise AssertionError('ChronicleFlow did not start on port %d' % self.port)

    def request(self, method, path, body=None, headers=None):
        conn = http.client.HTTPConnection('127.0.0.1', self.port, timeout=15)
        payload = None
        send = {}
        if body is not None:
            payload = json.dumps(body).encode('utf-8')
            send['Content-Type'] = 'application/json'
        for key, value in (headers or {}).items():
            send[key] = value
        conn.request(method, path, payload, send)
        response = conn.getresponse()
        data = response.read()
        conn.close()
        return response.status, data

    def stop(self):
        if self.proc.poll() is None:

"""Acceptance checks for execution version binding across a workflow upgrade."""

import http.client
import json
import socket
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
import time
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
SRCDIR = ROOT / 'src'


def free_port():
    sock = socket.socket(socket.AF_INET, socket.SOCK_STREAM)
    sock.bind(('127.0.0.1', 0))
    port = sock.getsockname()[1]
    sock.close()
    return port


class Product:
    def __init__(self, db_path):
        self.port = free_port()
        self.db_path = str(db_path)
        self.log = open(self.db_path + '.server.log', 'wb')
        self.proc = subprocess.Popen(
            [sys.executable, '-m', 'chronicleflow.server', '--host', '127.0.0.1',
             '--port', str(self.port), '--database', self.db_path],
            cwd=str(SRCDIR), stdout=self.log, stderr=self.log)
        deadline = time.time() + 30
        while time.time() < deadline:
            try:
                status, _ = self.request('GET', '/health')
                if status == 200:
                    return
            except OSError:
                pass
            time.sleep(0.1)
        raise AssertionError('ChronicleFlow did not start on port %d' % self.port)

    def request(self, method, path, body=None, headers=None):
        conn = http.client.HTTPConnection('127.0.0.1', self.port, timeout=15)
        payload = None
        send = {}
        if body is not None:
            payload = json.dumps(body).encode('utf-8')
            send['Content-Type'] = 'application/json'
        for key, value in (headers or {}).items():
            send[key] = value
        conn.request(method, path, payload, send)
        response = conn.getresponse()
        data = response.read()
        conn.close()
        return response.status, data

    def stop(self):
        if self.proc.poll() is None:
            self.proc.terminate()
            try:
                self.proc.wait(timeout=10)
            except Exception:
                self.proc.kill()
                self.proc.wait(timeout=10)
        self.log.close()


def check(condition, message):
    if not condition:
        raise AssertionError(message)


def stream_of(data):
    payload = json.loads(data)
    if isinstance(payload, dict):
        return payload['events']
    return payload


def main():
    tmp = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()
    product = Product(str(Path(tmp.name) / 'binding.db'))
    try:
        nodes_v1 = [
            {'id': 'a', 'kind': 'task', 'depends_on': []},
            {'id': 'b', 'kind': 'task', 'depends_on': ['a']},
        ]
        nodes_v2 = [
            {'id': 'a', 'kind': 'task', 'depends_on': []},
            {'id': 'c', 'kind': 'task', 'depends_on': ['a']},
        ]
        status, data = product.request(
            'POST', '/workflows',
            {'id': 'bind', 'version': 'v1', 'nodes': nodes_v1},
            {'Idempotency-Key': 'bind-v1'})
        check(status == 201, 'creating version v1 must be 201, got %d' % status)

        status, data = product.request(
            'POST', '/executions',
            {'id': 'run-old', 'workflow_id': 'bind', 'input': {}},
            {'Idempotency-Key': 'run-old'})
        check(status == 201, 'starting an execution must be 201, got %d' % status)
        check(json.loads(data).get('version') == 'v1',
              'an execution binds the version that is current at start, got %r' % (json.loads(data),))

        status, data = product.request(
            'POST', '/workflows',
            {'id': 'bind', 'version': 'v2', 'nodes': nodes_v2},
            {'Idempotency-Key': 'bind-v2'})
        check(status == 201, 'the upgrade must be accepted, got %d' % status)

        status, data = product.request(
            'POST', '/executions',
            {'id': 'run-new', 'workflow_id': 'bind', 'input': {}},
            {'Idempotency-Key': 'run-new'})
        check(status == 201, 'a later execution must start, got %d' % status)
        check(json.loads(data).get('version') == 'v2',
              'an execution started after the upgrade binds the new version, got %r' % (json.loads(data),))

        status, data = product.request(
            'POST', '/executions',
            {'id': 'run-pin', 'workflow_id': 'bind', 'version': 'v1', 'input': {}},
            {'Idempotency-Key': 'run-pin'})
        check(status == 201, 'an execution may name its version, got %d' % status)
        check(json.loads(data).get('version') == 'v1',
              'an execution binds the version it names, got %r' % (json.loads(data),))

        status, data = product.request(
            'POST', '/executions/run-old/advance', {'output': {'step': 1}},
            {'Idempotency-Key': 'old-adv-1'})
        check(status == 200, 'advancing must be 200, got %d' % status)
        state = json.loads(data)
        check(state['completed_nodes'] == ['a'],
              'the first ready node of v1 must complete, got %r' % (state['completed_nodes'],))

        status, data = product.request(
            'POST', '/executions/run-old/advance', {'output': {'step': 2}},
            {'Idempotency-Key': 'old-adv-2'})
        check(status == 200, 'advancing must be 200, got %d' % status)
        state = json.loads(data)
        check(state['status'] == 'completed', 'the run started before the upgrade must complete, got %r' % (state['status'],))
        check(state['completed_nodes'] == ['a', 'b'],
              'the running execution must finish its bound version, got %r' % (state['completed_nodes'],))
        check(state.get('version') == 'v1', 'the completed run keeps its bound version, got %r' % (state.get('version'),))

        for run_id, expected, marker in (('run-pin', ['a', 'b'], 'pin'), ('run-new', ['a', 'c'], 'new')):
            for step in (1, 2):
                status, data = product.request(
                    'POST', '/executions/%s/advance' % run_id, {'output': {'step': step}},
                    {'Idempotency-Key': '%s-adv-%d' % (marker, step)})
                check(status == 200, 'advancing %s must be 200, got %d' % (run_id, status))
            state = json.loads(data)
            check(state['status'] == 'completed', '%s must complete, got %r' % (run_id, state['status'],))
            check(state['completed_nodes'] == expected,
                  '%s must follow its bound version, got %r' % (run_id, state['completed_nodes'],))

        status, data = product.request('GET', '/executions/run-old/events')
        check(status == 200, 'the event stream must be queryable, got %d' % status)
        events = stream_of(data)
        check(events[0]['type'] == 'execution_started', 'the first event must be the start, got %r' % (events[0],))
        check(events[0]['payload'].get('version') == 'v1',
              'the start event must record the bound version, got %r' % (events[0]['payload'],))

        status, data = product.request(
            'POST', '/executions',
            {'id': 'run-ghost', 'workflow_id': 'bind', 'version': 'ghost', 'input': {}},
            {'Idempotency-Key': 'run-ghost'})
        check(status == 404, 'naming a missing version must be 404, got %d' % status)
        check(json.loads(data)['error']['code'] == 'not_found', 'a missing version must be not_found')
        status, data = product.request('GET', '/executions/run-ghost')
        check(status == 404, 'the rejected start must create no execution, got %d' % status)

        status, data = product.request(
            'POST', '/executions',
            {'id': 'run-nw', 'workflow_id': 'ghost', 'input': {}},
            {'Idempotency-Key': 'run-nw'})
        check(status == 404, 'naming a missing workflow must be 404, got %d' % status)
        check(json.loads(data)['error']['code'] == 'not_found', 'a missing workflow must be not_found')

        status, data = product.request(
            'POST', '/workflows',
            {'id': 'plain', 'nodes': [{'id': 'p', 'kind': 'task', 'depends_on': []}]},
            {'Idempotency-Key': 'plain-first'})
        check(status == 201, 'the unversioned workflow must be created, got %d' % status)
        status, data = product.request(
            'POST', '/executions',
            {'id': 'run-p', 'workflow_id': 'plain', 'input': {}},
            {'Idempotency-Key': 'run-p'})
        check(status == 201, 'the unversioned run must start, got %d' % status)
        check('version' not in json.loads(data),
              'an unversioned run gains no version field, got %r' % (json.loads(data),))
        status, data = product.request('GET', '/executions/run-p')
        check('version' not in json.loads(data), 'the state of an unversioned run gains no version field')
        status, data = product.request('GET', '/executions/run-p/events')
        events = stream_of(data)
        check('version' not in events[0]['payload'],
              'the start event of an unversioned run gains no version field, got %r' % (events[0],))

        status, data = product.request(
            'POST', '/workflows',
            {'id': 'plain', 'version': 'v1', 'nodes': [{'id': 'q', 'kind': 'task', 'depends_on': []}]},
            {'Idempotency-Key': 'plain-v1'})
        check(status == 201, 'the versionless workflow may be upgraded, got %d' % status)
        status, data = product.request(
            'POST', '/executions/run-p/advance', {'output': {'done': True}},
            {'Idempotency-Key': 'run-p-advance'})
        check(status == 200, 'the unversioned run must keep advancing, got %d' % status)
        state = json.loads(data)
        check(state['status'] == 'completed', 'the unversioned run must complete, got %r' % (state['status'],))
        check(state['completed_nodes'] == ['p'],
              'the unversioned run keeps its original definition, got %r' % (state['completed_nodes'],))
        check('version' not in state, 'the unversioned run keeps its exact state shape, got %r' % (state,))
    finally:
        product.stop()
        try:
            tmp.cleanup()
        except OSError:
            pass


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()

"""Acceptance checks for HTTP error codes, serialisation and request validation."""

import http.client
import json
import socket
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
import time
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
SRCDIR = ROOT / 'src'


def free_port():
    sock = socket.socket(socket.AF_INET, socket.SOCK_STREAM)
    sock.bind(('127.0.0.1', 0))
    port = sock.getsockname()[1]
    sock.close()
    return port


class Product:
    def __init__(self, db_path):
        self.port = free_port()
        self.db_path = str(db_path)
        self.log = open(self.db_path + '.server.log', 'wb')
        self.proc = subprocess.Popen(
            [sys.executable, '-m', 'chronicleflow.server', '--host', '127.0.0.1',
             '--port', str(self.port), '--database', self.db_path],
            cwd=str(SRCDIR), stdout=self.log, stderr=self.log)
        deadline = time.time() + 30
        while time.time() < deadline:
            try:
                status, _ = self.request('GET', '/health')
                if status == 200:
                    return
            except OSError:
                pass
            time.sleep(0.1)
        raise AssertionError('ChronicleFlow did not start on port %d' % self.port)

    def request(self, method, path, body=None, headers=None):
        conn = http.client.HTTPConnection('127.0.0.1', self.port, timeout=15)
        payload = None
        send = {}
        if body is not None:
            payload = json.dumps(body).encode('utf-8')
            send['Content-Type'] = 'application/json'
        for key, value in (headers or {}).items():
            send[key] = value
        conn.request(method, path, payload, send)
        response = conn.getresponse()
        data = response.read()
        conn.close()
        return response.status, data

    def stop(self):
        if self.proc.poll() is None:
            self.proc.terminate()
            try:
                self.proc.wait(timeout=10)
            except Exception:
                self.proc.kill()
                self.proc.wait(timeout=10)
        self.log.close()


def check(condition, message):
    if not condition:
        raise AssertionError(message)


def main():
    tmp = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()
    product = Product(str(Path(tmp.name) / 'contract.db'))
    try:
        node_a = [{'id': 'a', 'kind': 'task', 'depends_on': []}]

        status, data = product.request('GET', '/workflows/ghost')
        check(status == 404, 'a missing workflow must be 404, got %d' % status)
        error = json.loads(data)['error']
        check(error.get('code') == 'not_found', 'the error code must be not_found, got %r' % (error,))
        check(isinstance(error.get('message'), str) and error['message'],
              'the error must carry a message, got %r' % (error,))
        check(data.endswith(b'\n') and not data.endswith(b'\n\n'),
              'an error response also ends with exactly one newline')

        status, data = product.request(
            'POST', '/workflows',
            {'id': 'wf', 'nodes': node_a},
            {'Idempotency-Key': 'wf-plain'})
        check(status == 201, 'the workflow must be created, got %d' % status)

        cases = [
            ('POST', '/workflows', {'id': 'wf-bad'}, 'wf-missing-nodes'),
            ('POST', '/workflows', {'id': 'wf-bad', 'nodes': 'x'}, 'wf-bad-nodes'),
            ('POST', '/workflows', {'id': 'wf-bad', 'nodes': node_a, 'extra': 1}, 'wf-unknown'),
            ('POST', '/executions', {'id': 'e', 'workflow_id': 'wf'}, 'ex-missing-input'),
            ('POST', '/executions', {'id': 'e', 'workflow_id': 'wf', 'input': {}, 'extra': 1}, 'ex-unknown'),
            ('POST', '/executions', {'id': 'e', 'workflow_id': 'wf', 'input': {}, 'version': 5}, 'ex-bad-version'),
            ('POST', '/executions', {'id': 'e', 'workflow_id': 'wf', 'input': {}, 'version': ''}, 'ex-empty-version'),
        ]
        for method, path, body, key in cases:
            status, data = product.request(method, path, body, {'Idempotency-Key': key})
            check(status == 400, '%s %s must be 400, got %d' % (method, path, status))
            check(json.loads(data)['error']['code'] == 'validation_error',
                  '%s %s must report validation_error, got %r' % (method, path, json.loads(data)))

        status, data = product.request(
            'POST', '/executions',
            {'id': 'e-nan', 'workflow_id': 'wf', 'input': {'x': float('nan')}},
            {'Idempotency-Key': 'e-nan'})
        check(status == 400, 'a NaN in the body must be 400, got %d' % status)
        check(json.loads(data)['error']['code'] == 'validation_error',
              'a NaN in the body must be a validation error, got %r' % (json.loads(data),))
        status, data = product.request(
            'POST', '/executions',
            {'id': 'e-inf', 'workflow_id': 'wf', 'input': {'x': float('inf')}},
            {'Idempotency-Key': 'e-inf'})
        check(status == 400, 'an Infinity in the body must be 400, got %d' % status)
        check(json.loads(data)['error']['code'] == 'validation_error',
              'an Infinity in the body must be a validation error, got %r' % (json.loads(data),))

        status, data = product.request(
            'POST', '/executions',
            {'id': 'e-nw', 'workflow_id': 'ghost', 'input': {}},
            {'Idempotency-Key': 'e-nw'})
        check(status == 404, 'a missing workflow must be 404, got %d' % status)
        check(json.loads(data)['error']['code'] == 'not_found', 'a missing workflow must be not_found')
        status, data = product.request(
            'POST', '/executions',
            {'id': 'e-nv', 'workflow_id': 'wf', 'version': 'ghost', 'input': {}},
            {'Idempotency-Key': 'e-nv'})
        check(status == 404, 'a missing version must be 404, got %d' % status)
        check(json.loads(data)['error']['code'] == 'not_found', 'a missing version must be not_found')
        status, data = product.request('GET', '/executions/ghost')
        check(status == 404, 'a missing execution must be 404, got %d' % status)
        status, data = product.request(
            'POST', '/executions/ghost/advance', {'output': {}},
            {'Idempotency-Key': 'adv-ghost'})
        check(status == 404, 'advancing a missing execution must be 404, got %d' % status)
        check(json.loads(data)['error']['code'] == 'not_found', 'a missing execution must be not_found')

        status, data = product.request(
            'POST', '/workflows',
            {'id': 'conf', 'version': 'v1', 'nodes': node_a},
            {'Idempotency-Key': 'conf-v1'})
        check(status == 201, 'the versioned workflow must be created, got %d' % status)
        status, data = product.request(
            'POST', '/workflows',
            {'id': 'conf', 'version': 'v1', 'nodes': node_a},
            {'Idempotency-Key': 'conf-v1-again'})
        check(status == 409, 'a duplicate version tag must be 409, got %d' % status)
        check(json.loads(data)['error']['code'] == 'conflict', 'a duplicate version tag must be a conflict')
        status, data = product.request(
            'POST', '/workflows',
            {'id': 'conf', 'nodes': node_a},
            {'Idempotency-Key': 'conf-untagged'})
        check(status == 409, 'an untagged post to an existing workflow must be 409, got %d' % status)
        check(json.loads(data)['error']['code'] == 'conflict', 'an untagged post must be a conflict')
        status, data = product.request(
            'POST', '/workflows',
            {'id': 'float-wf', 'nodes': node_a},
            {'Idempotency-Key': 'conf-v1'})
        check(status == 409, 'reusing an idempotency key across operations must be 409, got %d' % status)
        check(json.loads(data)['error']['code'] == 'conflict', 'an idempotency key reuse must be a conflict')

        status, data = product.request(
            'POST', '/workflows',
            {'id': 'float-wf', 'nodes': node_a},
            {'Idempotency-Key': 'float-wf'})
        check(status == 201, 'the float workflow must be created, got %d' % status)
        status, data = product.request(
            'POST', '/executions',
            {'id': 'run-f', 'workflow_id': 'float-wf', 'input': {'in': 1}},
            {'Idempotency-Key': 'run-f'})
        check(status == 201, 'run-f must start, got %d' % status)
        status, data = product.request(
            'POST', '/executions/run-f/advance',
            {'output': {'z': -0.0, 'p': 0.12345678901234567}},
            {'Idempotency-Key': 'run-f-adv'})
        check(status == 200, 'the advance must be accepted, got %d' % status)
        check(b'-0.0' in data, 'negative zero must be preserved, got %r' % (data,))
        check(b'0.12345678901234567' in data, 'float precision must be preserved, got %r' % (data,))
        check(data.endswith(b'\n') and not data.endswith(b'\n\n'),
              'every response ends with exactly one newline')
        status, data = product.request('GET', '/executions/run-f')
        check(status == 200, 'the execution must be queryable, got %d' % status)
        check(b'-0.0' in data and b'0.12345678901234567' in data,
              'the stored values keep their precision, got %r' % (data,))

        status, data = product.request('GET', '/workflows/float-wf')
        check(status == 200, 'the definition query must be 200, got %d' % status)
        definition = json.loads(data)
        check(list(definition.keys()) == ['current_version', 'id', 'versions'],
              'new fields must be written in stable key order, got %r' % (list(definition.keys()),))
        check(data.endswith(b'\n') and not data.endswith(b'\n\n'),
              'every response ends with exactly one newline')
    finally:
        product.stop()
        try:
            tmp.cleanup()
        except OSError:
            pass


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()

        self.send_header("Content-Type", "application/json; charset=utf-8")
        self.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(body)))

    def create_workflow(self, workflow_id, schedule=None):
        body = {"id": workflow_id, "nodes": [{"id": "a", "kind": "task", "depends_on": []}]}
        if schedule is not None:
            body["schedule"] = schedule
        status, data = self.call("POST", "/workflows", body, key=f"create-{workflow_id}")
        self.assertEqual(201, status, data)

    def test_interval_schedule_fires_and_status_reports(self):
        self.create_workflow(
            "wf-s1",
            {"interval_seconds": 1, "input": {"n": 1}, "missed_policy": "catch_up"},
        )
        status, data = self.call("GET", "/workflows/wf-s1/schedule")
        self.assertEqual(200, status)
        self.assertTrue(data.endswith(b"\n"))
        self.assertFalse(data.endswith(b"\n\n"))
        payload = json.loads(data)
        self.assertEqual(
            {"interval_seconds": 1, "input": {"n": 1}, "missed_policy": "catch_up"},
            payload["schedule"],
        )
        self.assertFalse(payload["paused"])
        self.assertIsNone(payload["last_triggered_at"])
        self.assertIsNone(payload["last_execution_id"])

        time.sleep(1.3)
        status, data = self.call("GET", "/workflows/wf-s1/schedule")
        self.assertEqual(200, status)
        payload = json.loads(data)
        self.assertEqual("wf-s1-scheduled-i:1", payload["last_execution_id"])
        self.assertIsNotNone(payload["last_triggered_at"])

        # The created execution looks exactly like a manually created one.
        status, data = self.call("GET", "/executions/wf-s1-scheduled-i:1")
        self.assertEqual(200, status)
        state = json.loads(data)
        self.assertEqual("running", state["status"])
        self.assertEqual({"n": 1}, state["input"])
        self.assertEqual("wf-s1", state["workflow_id"])
        status, data = self.call("GET", "/executions/wf-s1-scheduled-i:1/events")
        self.assertEqual(["execution_started"], [event["type"] for event in json.loads(data)["events"]])

        # It advances with the usual semantics.
        status, data = self.call(
            "POST", "/executions/wf-s1-scheduled-i:1/advance", {"output": {"done": True}}, key="adv-s1"
        )
        self.assertEqual(200, status)
        self.assertEqual("completed", json.loads(data)["status"])

    def test_scheduled_execution_has_manual_state_shape(self):
        self.create_workflow("wf-shape", {"interval_seconds": 1, "input": {}, "missed_policy": "skip"})
        self.call(
            "POST",
            "/executions",
            {"id": "run-shape-manual", "workflow_id": "wf-shape", "input": {}},
            key="ex-shape-manual",
        )
        status, data = self.call("GET", "/executions/run-shape-manual")
        manual_keys = set(json.loads(data))
        time.sleep(1.3)
        status, data = self.call("GET", "/workflows/wf-shape/schedule")
        scheduled_id = json.loads(data)["last_execution_id"]
        self.assertIsNotNone(scheduled_id)
        status, data = self.call("GET", f"/executions/{scheduled_id}")
        self.assertEqual(200, status)
        self.assertEqual(manual_keys, set(json.loads(data)))

    def test_query_without_schedule_is_definite_empty_result(self):
        self.create_workflow("wf-nosched")
        status, data = self.call("GET", "/workflows/wf-nosched/schedule")
        self.assertEqual(200, status)
        self.assertEqual({"schedule": None}, json.loads(data))

    def test_schedule_operations_on_missing_workflow_are_not_found(self):
        status, data = self.call("GET", "/workflows/nope/schedule")
        self.assertEqual(404, status)
        self.assertEqual("not_found", json.loads(data)["error"]["code"])
        status, data = self.call("POST", "/workflows/nope/schedule/pause", {}, key="p-nope")
        self.assertEqual(404, status)
        status, data = self.call("POST", "/workflows/nope/schedule/resume", {}, key="r-nope")

            "/workflows/nope/schedule",

            key="u-nope",
        )

        status, data = self.call("POST", "/workflows/wf-nosched/schedule/pause", {}, key="p-nosched")

def test_cron_schedule_is_accepted_and_reported(self):
        self.create_workflow(
            "wf-cron",
            {"cron": "*/5 9-17 1,15 * 1-5", "input": {"mode": "cron"}, "missed_policy": "catch_up"},
        )
        status, data = self.call("GET", "/workflows/wf-cron/schedule")
        self.assertEqual(200, status)
        payload = json.loads(data)
        self.assertEqual("*/5 9-17 1,15 * 1-5", payload["schedule"]["cron"])
        self.assertEqual("catch_up", payload["schedule"]["missed_policy"])
        self.assertIsNone(payload["last_execution_id"])

    def test_pause_halts_and_catch_up_fires_only_latest_missed(self):
        self.create_workflow("wf-s2", {"interval_seconds": 1, "input": {}, "missed_policy": "catch_up"})
        status, data = self.call("POST", "/workflows/wf-s2/schedule/pause", {}, key="pause-s2")
        self.assertEqual(200, status)
        self.assertTrue(json.loads(data)["paused"])
        time.sleep(2.4)
        status, data = self.call("GET", "/workflows/wf-s2/schedule")
        self.assertIsNone(json.loads(data)["last_execution_id"])
        status, data = self.call("POST", "/workflows/wf-s2/schedule/resume", {}, key="resume-s2")
        self.assertEqual(200, status)
        payload = json.loads(data)
        self.assertFalse(payload["paused"])
        # Only the most recent missed period is made up, exactly once.
        self.assertEqual("wf-s2-scheduled-i:2", payload["last_execution_id"])
        status, _ = self.call("GET", "/executions/wf-s2-scheduled-i:1")
        self.assertEqual(404, status)
        status, _ = self.call("GET", "/executions/wf-s2-scheduled-i:2")
        self.assertEqual(200, status)

    def test_pause_and_skip_policy_never_makes_up_missed_periods(self):
        self.create_workflow("wf-s3", {"interval_seconds": 1, "input": {}, "missed_policy": "skip"})
        status, _ = self.call("POST", "/workflows/wf-s3/schedule/pause", {}, key="pause-s3")
        self.assertEqual(200, status)
        time.sleep(2.4)
        status, data = self.call("POST", "/workflows/wf-s3/schedule/resume", {}, key="resume-s3")
        self.assertEqual(200, status)
        payload = json.loads(data)
        self.assertIsNone(payload["last_execution_id"])
        self.assertIsNone(payload["last_triggered_at"])
        # New periods still fire after the resume.
        time.sleep(1.3)
        status, data = self.call("GET", "/workflows/wf-s3/schedule")
        payload = json.loads(data)
        self.assertTrue(payload["last_execution_id"].startswith("wf-s3-scheduled-i:"))

    def test_update_schedule_on_existing_workflow(self):
        self.create_workflow("wf-s4")
        status, data = self.call(
            "PUT",
            "/workflows/wf-s4/schedule",
            {"interval_seconds": 5, "input": {"x": 1}, "missed_policy": "skip"},
            key="upd-s4",
        )
        self.assertEqual(200, status)
        payload = json.loads(data)
        self.assertEqual(
            {"interval_seconds": 5, "input": {"x": 1}, "missed_policy": "skip"}, payload["schedule"]
        )
        self.assertFalse(payload["paused"])
        # Replacing the plan works the same way.
        status, data = self.call(
            "PUT",
            "/workflows/wf-s4/schedule",
            {"cron": "0 9 * * 1", "input": {}, "missed_policy": "catch_up"},
            key="upd-s4b",
        )
        self.assertEqual(200, status)
        self.assertEqual("0 9 * * 1", json.loads(data)["schedule"]["cron"])
        # Invalid replacement plans are rejected and the old plan survives.
        status, data = self.call(
            "PUT",
            "/workflows/wf-s4/schedule",
            {"interval_seconds": 1, "cron": "* * * * *", "input": {}, "missed_policy": "skip"},
            key="upd-s4c",
        )
        self.assertEqual(400, status)
        self.assertEqual("validation_error", json.loads(data)["error"]["code"])
        status, data = self.call("GET", "/workflows/wf-s4/schedule")
        self.assertEqual("0 9 * * 1", json.loads(data)["schedule"]["cron"])

    def test_schedule_operation_body_validation(self):
        self.create_workflow("wf-s5", {"interval_seconds": 60, "input": {}, "missed_policy": "skip"})
        for index, raw in enumerate((b'{"note":"x"}', b"[1]", b'"pause"', b'{"v":NaN}')):
            status, data = self.call("POST", "/workflows/wf-s5/schedule/pause", raw=raw, key=f"pb-{index}")
            self.assertEqual(400, status, raw)
            self.assertEqual("validation_error", json.loads(data)["error"]["code"])
            status, data = self.call("POST", "/workflows/wf-s5/schedule/resume", raw=raw, key=f"rb-{index}")
            self.assertEqual(400, status, raw)
        status, data = self.call("POST", "/workflows/wf-s5/schedule/pause", {})
        self.assertEqual(400, status)
        self.assertEqual("validation_error", json.loads(data)["error"]["code"])

    def test_idempotency_key_reuse_across_schedule_operations_conflicts(self):
        self.create_workflow("wf-s6", {"interval_seconds": 60, "input": {}, "missed_policy": "skip"})
        status, data = self.call("POST", "/workflows/wf-s6/schedule/pause", {}, key="sched-shared")
        self.assertEqual(200, status)
        # Repeating the same operation with the same key replays the result.
        status, data = self.call("POST", "/workflows/wf-s6/schedule/pause", {}, key="sched-shared")
        self.assertEqual(200, status)
        self.assertTrue(json.loads(data)["paused"])
        status, data = self.call("POST", "/workflows/wf-s6/schedule/resume", {}, key="sched-shared")
        self.assertEqual(409, status)
        self.assertEqual("conflict", json.loads(data)["error"]["code"])
        status, data = self.call(
            "PUT",
            "/workflows/wf-s6/schedule",
            {"interval_seconds": 30, "input": {}, "missed_policy": "skip"},
            key="sched-shared",
        )
        self.assertEqual(409, status)

content.thinking: This is an interesting case — when an execution migrates from version A to version B, the execution engine does not need to know the version of historical nodes during migration. It processes events sequentially, checks completed node IDs against the current node graph during replay, marks nodes as completed or ready to run accordingly, and reconstructs the original state from events. Nodes completed in the old version but absent in the new one remain harmlessly in the completed nodes set. Orphaned IDs are allowed as long as the dependency definition is malformed, and cross-version graph consistency isn't validated during migration. Approval processes for nodes not in the new version also skip graph checks, which is acceptable as their conclusions belong to the old version. I'll start implementation with schedule nesting.

pause, resume, and update endpoints return the same `schedule` object shape.

def nodes_v2():
    return [

        {"id": "ship", "kind": "task", "depends_on": ["reserve"]},
        {"id": "notify", "kind": "task", "depends_on": ["ship"]},

class MigrationServiceTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.directory = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()
        self.service = ChronicleFlow(str(Path(self.directory.name) / "migrate.db"))
        self.service.create_workflow(
            {"id": "orders", "version": "v1", "nodes": nodes_v1()}, "wf-v1"
        )
        self.service.create_workflow(
            {"id": "orders", "version": "v2", "nodes": nodes_v2()}, "wf-v2"
        )

    def tearDown(self):
        self.directory.cleanup()

    def start(self, execution_id="run-1", version="v1"):
        return self.service.create_execution(
            {"id": execution_id, "workflow_id": "orders", "version": version, "input": {}},
            f"ex-{execution_id}",
        )

    def test_migration_binds_target_and_keeps_history(self):
        self.start()
        first = self.service.advance("run-1", {"output": {"id": 1}}, "adv-1")
        self.assertEqual(["reserve"], first["completed_nodes"])
        migrated = self.service.migrate("run-1", {"version": "v2"}, "mig-1")
        self.assertEqual("v2", migrated["version"])

    @classmethod

    def call(self, method, path, body=None, key=None):
        connection = http.client.HTTPConnection("127.0.0.1", self.port)
        payload = json.dumps(body) if body is not None else None
        headers = {"Content-Type": "application/json"}
        if key is not None:
            headers["Idempotency-Key"] = key
        connection.request(method, path, payload, headers)
        response = connection.getresponse()
        data = response.read()
        connection.close()
        return response.status, data

import http.client
import json
import tempfile
import threading
import unittest
from http.server import ThreadingHTTPServer
from pathlib import Path

from chronicleflow.server import Handler
from chronicleflow.service import ChronicleFlow


class HttpTransportTests(unittest.TestCase):
    @classmethod
    def setUpClass(cls):
        cls.directory = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()
        Handler.service = ChronicleFlow(str(Path(cls.directory.name) / "http.db"))
        cls.server = ThreadingHTTPServer(("127.0.0.1", 0), Handler)
        cls.port = cls.server.server_address[1]
        cls.thread = threading.Thread(target=cls.server.serve_forever, daemon=True)
        cls.thread.start()

    @classmethod
    def tearDownClass(cls):
        cls.server.shutdown()
        cls.server.server_close()
        cls.directory.cleanup()

    def request(self, method, path, body=None, raw=None, headers=None):
        connection = http.client.HTTPConnection("127.0.0.1", self.port)
        payload = raw if raw is not None else (json.dumps(body) if body is not None else None)
        all_headers = {"Content-Type": "application/json"}
        all_headers.update(headers or {})
        connection.request(method, path, payload, all_headers)
        response = connection.getresponse()
        data = response.read()
        connection.close()
        return response.status, data

    def test_health_response_ends_with_single_newline(self):
        status, data = self.request("GET", "/health")
        self.assertEqual(200, status)
        self.assertTrue(data.endswith(b"\n"))
        self.assertFalse(data.endswith(b"\n\n"))
        self.assertEqual({"status": "ok"}, json.loads(data))

    def test_workflow_creation_response_ends_with_newline(self):
        status, data = self.request(
            "POST",
            "/workflows",
            {"id": "wf-nl", "nodes": [{"id": "a", "kind": "task", "depends_on": []}]},
            headers={"Idempotency-Key": "wf-nl"},
        )
        self.assertEqual(201, status)
        self.assertTrue(data.endswith(b"\n"))
        self.assertFalse(data.endswith(b"\n\n"))

    def test_error_response_ends_with_newline(self):
        status, data = self.request("GET", "/executions/missing")
        self.assertEqual(404, status)
